name: Deferred Shading for Isosurfaces
definition: A multi-pass image-space shading technique that computes surface properties (position, gradient, Hessian, curvature) in separate passes and uses them in a final shading pass. Complexity is independent of grid size.
summary: Deferred Shading for Isosurfaces is a multi-pass technique that pre-computes surface properties like curvature in intermediate buffers to enable advanced shading effects, distinguishing itself by decoupling shading from volume sampling.
